machineScope.reason: Retains memory without compaction or deletion (the register growth category is unbounded); host admission separately caps retained rows and refuses further input. Machine-local encrypted host custody under the existing conversation owner fence. Accepted input and outcomes are retained up to 4096 rows with 64 pending and bounded input bytes; capacity refusal never deletes memory. Exact local process identities cannot be adopted on another machine. The outer journal retains its existing replication policy; this snapshot introduces no peer transfer.

agreesWith.invariant: On each ordinary host work tick, collect the durable outcome by original operation into the existing reserved journal consumer only when its prepared packet matches exactly. Queued custody remains pending; uncertain dispatch is never replayed; completed results pass the existing answer review and one durable send intent. Full host outcomes remain authoritative execution evidence and the journal remains authoritative publication evidence.
